text:
**Short answer:** for most iPhone 17 owners, I'd get the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K). If you want more capacity and the fastest wireless speed, get the INIU SnapGo Air (10K).

**Best slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It is 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging. Anker's page lists the iPhone 17 series as supported. [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than the competition ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- 5,000mAh typically gets a phone to about 60-75% ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $52.99 at Amazon**
- Android Central's tester found it the thinnest and lightest of the bunch, at 0.27" and 104g.
- The catch is that wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker. [Android Central review, with Amazon links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Best slim 10K with fast charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh), about $42.99 at Amazon**
- It is 0.5" thick and weighs 195g. It supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which the iPhone 17 can use, and 45W wired charging. It also has a built-in lanyard-style cable.
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe battery pack. Android Central praised its value. [Android Central review, with Amazon link](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Another 10K option: Baseus PicoGo AM52, $53.99 with code AM52**
- It has 25W Qi2.2 wireless and 45W wired charging. The page I found doesn't list its thickness, so I can't say how slim it is. [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) (an affiliate link, and the code is listed as tested on Oct 24).

**What to keep in mind**
- The 25W Qi2.2 speed works on the iPhone 16 and later, so your iPhone 17 qualifies.
- The Anker page warns that thick or non-magnetic cases, such as OtterBox Defender, can break the connection. Metal attachments like cards or pop grips also interfere.
- Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
